_comment: Public repositories that scout.mjs fetches and scans. Add an entry to scan another repository.
repo: owner/name on GitHub. globs: the skill folders, relative to the repository root ('*' stays within one folder level, '**' crosses levels).
note: a Japanese note shown in the report. url (optional): a clone URL other than https://github.com/<repo>.git.
The cache folder is named after the repository part of 'repo', so two entries must not share it.
